description: Klaviyo is a marketing automation platform for email, SMS, and social campaigns.
access_requirements: Free account with self‑service API key generation
evidence_excerpts: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
Private key authentication for /api endpoints is performed by setting the following request header: Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key your-private-api-key
All /api endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes to authenticate requests.
If you are a tech partner integrating with Klaviyo, we recommend using OAuth to authenticate your app.
